19 March 2026

ECB staff macroeconomic projections for the euro area, March 2026

1 Overview

Inflation is projected to return to the 2% target over the projection horizon, while real GDP growth is projected to firm gradually.

2 Macroeconomic projections for the euro area economy

The March 2026 projections were compiled against the December 2025 projections. Revisions relative to the December 2025 projections are shown in percentage points.

Table 1 — March 2026 projections for the euro area (annual percentage changes)
